programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: El duelo ha terminado y todos se dirigen a la oficina para votar. Sigifredo es el encargado de contar los votos, pero los resultados serán alterados. Por otro lado, Martin y Emiliano hablan de la llegada de este a México.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Rosario y Emiliano cantan a dúo muy enamorados. Mientras tanto, Martin se va llorando para el hotel. Por otro lado, Emiliano le dice a Rosario que su familia ya consiguió la plata para el pasaje y que se va en unos días, pero promete volver.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Sigifredo celebra el bautizo de su nieta en compañía del grupo de mariachis. Por otro lado, Martin llega a México y le informa a Steve que va para el rancho a confesarle la verdad a Roberto Sanchez. Steve pondrá sobre aviso a Corona.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Eulalia de Malagón pierde el control a ver a Carlos cerca de la señora Raquel. Por otro lado, los hombres de Thomas le hacen una emboscada a Martin en la carretera y lo asesinan. Don Roberto ordena buscar a Martin al ver que se está tardando.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Cristina entra en crisis de llanto al enterarse de la muerte de Martin. Por otro lado, Emiliano continúa ilusionado y malgasta el dinero sin saber lo que le sucedió a Martin.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Emiliano se encuentra impaciente por la falta de comunicación con Martin. Por otro lado, Thomas amenaza a Miguel Corona y le advierte que si Emiliano habla, se encargara de matar a toda su familia y a la de Felipe Romero.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Mañanitas queda destrozado al ver que la mujer que intenta conquistar esta con Jairo. Emiliano se lleva a Mañanitas a la pensión y le pide a Lourdes que le quite la virginidad. Por otro lado, Fernando le cuenta a Emiliano lo de la muerte de Martin.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi

programme.title: La hija del mariachi

programme.title: What Would You Do?
programme.desc: Using hidden cameras, host John Quiñones observes and comments on how ordinary people behave when they are confronted with dilemmas that require them either to take action or to walk by and mind their own business. Various scenarios are created that force people to make split-second -- and often surprising -- decisions, and variations of the situation (such as changing the genders, races or clothing of the people involved) are often featured to see if different reactions are elicited. Examples of situations on the show include a waitress being harassed by her boss, and a drunken valet trying to park cars.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: With a long record of violence and abuse and weighing in at over 200lbs, Dog's target for the day does not sound like a gentle giant. When the trail grows cold Dog turns up the heat on the fugitive's brother and sister.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: As Dog likes to say, "it's not the years it's the miles," and this goes for both men and machines. Those long hunts and the rides to jail take a toll not only on Dog but also on his vehicles.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Dog is trying to cut down on smoking, but it's not easy with his high-stress job. Today, he must track down Walter, a fugitive who believes that the Canadian military has planted a chip in his tooth.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: There's no rest for the righteous and nobody knows this better then the Dog. He is committed to saving his new friend's bail bonding business, and now must race against time to bring a rogues gallery to justice.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: It hurts Dog to see people who after years of walking the straight and narrow, suddenly lose their way. But today's case is a member of the law enforcement community who has recently gone astray, and that truly troubles the Dog.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: This hunt is personal. Dog's good friend and fellow bondsman Chris is running out of time. He has only days to find his fugitive or risk losing his business. In his hunt Dog confronts duplicitous tipsters, vicious attack dogs, and hostile neighbors.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Dog and Beth are finally getting married! They've been together for more than ten years but Dog is determined, as he puts it, to "marry his common law wife the Christian way." There are big nuptials planned on the Big Island.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Today's fugitive is accused of assaulting a police officer, so Dog and the team are not taking any chances. While on the Big Island and Dog convinces the felon's friends and family to join forces and then learns he has fled to another island.

programme.title: The Cariboo Trail
programme.desc: During the Gold Rush, two dreamers from Montana and a prospector head for British Columbia to raise cattle and dig for gold, but find trouble instead.

programme.title: Wagon Master
programme.desc: To survive a perilous crossing of the vast Utah desert, a band of Mormons must learn to collaborate with the people they meet on the trail.

programme.title: The Law vs. Billy the Kid
programme.desc: The notorious gunslinger’s new courtship with a rancher's lovely daughter is cut prematurely short when the law unexpectedly catches up with him.

programme.title: The Cimarron Kid
programme.desc: A paroled outlaw (Audie Murphy) tries to change for a rancher's daughter (Beverly Tyler), but the Dalton gang won't let him.

programme.title: Whispering Smith
programme.desc: Luke Whispering Smith (Alan Ladd) is a mild-mannered policeman tasked with stopping a gang of train robbers, led by Barney Rebstock (Donald Crisp). Luke is faced with a conflict of interest when his good friend, Murray Sinclair (Robert Preston), loses his railroad job and, in an act of defiance, joins Rebstock's gang of outlaws. To make things even more complicated, Luke's friendship with Murray's ex-wife, Marian (Brenda Marshall), is becoming romantic.

programme.title: Saskatchewan
programme.desc: Canadian Mountie O'Rourke (Alan Ladd) and his Cree companion, Cajou (Jay Silverheels), come upon the scorched remains of a wagon train and find beautiful lone survivor Grace (Shelley Winters), who claims the attack was carried out by American Indians. Realizing the attack is only the beginning, the men fear war between the American Sioux, the Canadian Cree and the whites. O'Rourke must now protect his troops from further attack and save Grace from being extradited to Montana on a murder charge.

programme.title: Riders of the Purple Sage
programme.desc: Based on the book by Zane Grey.

programme.title: Appaloosa
programme.desc: Two gunmen pursue an escaped murderer to a lawless Western town, where a mysterious widow with a dangerous agenda draws them into trouble.

programme.title: Destry Rides Again
programme.desc: The small town of Bottleneck is under the control of Kent (Brian Donlevy), a power-hungry boss who gets control over the local cattle ranchers by winning a rigged game of cards. When the local sheriff questions the legitimacy of the game, Kent has him killed and names the town drunk, Dimsdale (Charles Winninger), as sheriff. What Kent doesn't know is that Dimsdale knows legendary lawman Tom Destry, who in turns sends his daring son Tom Destry Jr. (James Stewart) to Bottleneck to save the day.

programme.title: Zane Grey Theater
programme.desc: A farmer must choose between his land and his son.

programme.title: Zane Grey Theater
programme.desc: A disabled gunfighter uses his son to exact revenge.

programme.title: Zane Grey Theater
programme.desc: A bank teller and a female doctor find themselves caught up in robbery and murder.

programme.title: Zane Grey Theater
programme.desc: A dishonored Army officer pursues a missing major for the government.

programme.title: Zane Grey Theater
programme.desc: A lawman and a bounty hunter hold the fates of a young outlaw and his fiancée in their hands.

programme.title: Zane Grey Theater
programme.desc: A brave man's reputation suffers under torture.

programme.title: The Texan
programme.desc: After Longley is forced to kill a barfly that tried to shoot him in the back, he learns a quirk in the Montana law code.

programme.title: The Texan
programme.desc: While escorting to prison the leader of a notorious gang, a sheriff and a deputy are attacked by the gang.

programme.title: Bend of the River
programme.desc: Reformed outlaw Glyn McLyntock (James Stewart) has become a guide for farmers headed to Oregon. When he rescues thief Emerson Cole (Arthur Kennedy) from execution, Cole joins him on the journey. Once the settlers arrive, they discover that a trader who was supposed to send them provisions is now trying to scam them. After McLyntock and Cole travel to Portland to forcibly retrieve the supplies, Cole betrays McLyntock and steals the goods himself. McLyntock pursues, ready for battle.

programme.title: Abilene Town
programme.desc: An honorable sheriff tries to make peace in his Western town when a feud breaks out between homesteaders and cattlemen in the wake of the Civil War.

programme.title: Arizona Bushwhackers

programme.title: The Gun Hawk
programme.desc: Shot by a sheriff (Rod Cameron), an old gunfighter (Rory Calhoun) returns to his hide-out to die with dignity.

programme.title: The Treasure of Pancho Villa
programme.desc: A U.S. mercenary (Rory Calhoun) and a Mexican rebel (Gilbert Roland) steal a shipment of gold for the revolution.

programme.title: Six Black Horses

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Whilst the Upper Marshwood hunt assemble outside the village inn, a filthy tramp-like man leaves the shop and skulks into the wood. Running for cover, towards the safety of his home-made shelter, he stumbles and falls into a pit - screaming. LIZA, isolated in the disused railway carriage which constitutes her home, moves deeper into the wood having heard the scream. She finds the pit and sees the tramp lying crumpled on the ground, clearly dead. She stares at him for a moment, then turns and walks away.

programme.title: El de los lentes Carrera
programme.desc: Después de un brutal enfrentamiento con Manuel, conocido como El Ondeado, Ángel del Villar queda al borde de la muerte. Mientras él lucha por sobrevivir a sus heridas, Karina y Monserrat caen en las garras de El Belicón, quien ha logrado tomar el control absoluto de la Federación, desatando una nueva era de terror. Pero el mayor peligro aún está por llegar. El Belicón revela su arma secreta: El Centinela, una máquina de combate humana, imparable y letal.

programme.title: La Sorpresa

programme.desc: La felicidad de una familia se quiebra cuando secuestran a su hija. Al mismo tiempo, se descubrirá la red de engaños entre su sobrino y su esposa, además de un nexo con un narcotraficante.

programme.title: Angry Planet | Avalanche

Host of Angry Planet George Kourounis travels with a variety of experts to bring down huge avalanches in the Rocky Mountains. Ski Patrollers throw hand charges to clear the slopes, the British Columbia Department of Highways uses helicopter bombing and mountaintop mortars to keep the roads safe, and the Canadian Armed Forces fire 105mm howitzers at the mountains to bring down the dangerous snow. Still, there are accidents and fatalities in the mountains. We meet Francois Desroisers, an avalanche burial victim who tells a terrible and tragic tale of a mountain disaster.

Host George Kourounis travels to Ushuaia, Argentina, sails south on the expedition sailboat “Northanger” to round infamous Cape Horn, then climbs the spectacular but rapidly melting glaciers along the Beagle Channel.
